verdict.rationale: The docs say AI Gateway load-balances requests across multiple LLM models (docs-17) and routes dynamically across providers through a provider-agnostic API (docs-31, docs-1). That is the foundation for failover, but no item explicitly describes automatic fallback when a model or provider fails. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure-triggered fallback/retry to another model or provider, configuration details for fallback order or conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
